_comment: Every line in the shipped lang.yml, and how it is covered.
A key with a 'case' is rewritten to a sentinel by that sweep and only passes when
the sentinel comes back, which proves the line is read rather than that the
fallback happens to say the same thing.
A key with 'pending' says why it is not driven. Most are error paths that need the
filesystem or the JAR to be broken on purpose, or notices that need a real
connected client. A key in NEITHER is a build failure, so a line added later

config-version.pending: a schema marker, not a message: it is never shown to anyone

chat.prefix.pending: nothing in the plugin calls Lang.prefixed, so this line is never used; the two messages that show a prefix have it written into their own value instead

chat.reload-config-ahead.pending: needs a config.yml from a newer schema than this build

chat.reload-config-ahead-fix.pending: needs a config.yml from a newer schema than this build

chat.reload-config-upgraded.pending: needs a config.yml from an older schema, mid-migration

chat.webhook-private.pending: only sent when the sender is a Player, and the console never is

chat.webhook-set.pending: sets a live webhook; driven for behaviour by ServerBootTest instead

chat.webhook-write-failed.pending: needs config.yml to be unwritable at the moment of the write

chat.webhook-rejected.pending: needs the plugin to save a webhook and then refuse it

chat.regen-done.pending: regen replaces lang.yml, so the rewritten line is gone before it prints

chat.regen-backup.pending: regen replaces lang.yml, so the rewritten line is gone before it prints

chat.regen-no-webhook.pending: regen replaces lang.yml, so the rewritten line is gone before it prints

chat.regen-no-bundled.pending: needs a build with no bundled defaults, which is not a build we ship

chat.regen-read-failed.pending: needs the bundled resource to be unreadable inside the JAR

chat.regen-write-failed.pending: needs the target file to be unwritable at the moment of the write

chat.no-permission.pending: the console always has permission, so only a real player reaches it

chat.config-ahead.pending: shown to an operator on join, which needs a real connected client

chat.config-ahead-fix.pending: shown to an operator on join, which needs a real connected client

chat.nightly-notice.pending: only ever printed by a nightly build

discord.platform-field.pending: needs Floodgate installed to produce a Bedrock player

discord.platform-bedrock.pending: needs Floodgate installed to produce a Bedrock player
